description: Defines classes and methods for testing disk cache functionality in Chromium, including DiskCacheTest and DiskCacheTestWithCache, with support for cache operations, setup, teardown, and cache management.

classes.name: DiskCacheTest
classes.description: Base class for disk cache related tests, manages cache directory setup and cleanup.

classes.name: DiskCacheTestWithCache
classes.description: Extends DiskCacheTest to provide cache creation, management, and testing utilities, including nested TestIterator class.

methods.name: CopyTestCache
methods.description: Copies cache files from data folder to test folder.

methods.name: CreateBackend
methods.description: Creates cache backend with specified flags.

methods.name: OpenOrCreateEntry
methods.description: Opens or creates a cache entry by key.

methods.name: DoomEntry
methods.description: Deletes a cache entry by key.

methods.name: CalculateSizeOfAllEntries
methods.description: Calculates total size of cache entries.
